get.description:
Return a human-readable readiness message for the frontend.

Returns:
    A typed status response confirming that the API is ready.

post.description: Execute the full synthetic recovery pipeline for demonstration.
Mint a short-lived token for a named synthetic actor.
post.summary: Mint a synthetic demo access token

post.description:
Start one running occurrence of a lecture on the shared clock.

The authenticated user becomes the session owner. The ``lecture_id``
identifies the lecture record and the returned ``session_id`` identifies
this occurrence.

get.description: Return the session for an authenticated owner, participant, or professor.
Return recorded provider usage, labeled synthetic in mock mode.

schema.title: Response Read Cost Metrics Api V1 Sessions  Session Id  Cost Metrics Get

post.description:
Ingest coarse, timestamped missed-content signal events.

Raw webcam frames, continuous raw audio, and screenshots are never
accepted; unexpected fields are rejected by contract validation.
post.summary: Ingest a batch of signal events

post.description: Apply the student's confirmation or denial of missed content.
Opt the authenticated user into anonymous, aggregated participation.

get.description:
Return an anonymous, aggregated summary for the course professor.

Aggregates are suppressed below the configured minimum group size and
never include student identifiers or individual confidence values.
Return one personal recovery card to its owner or the session owner.
